meta.title: About — Contivo
meta.description: Who builds Contivo, the rules it is built on, and where it honestly stands today.

about.headline: Run on its founder's <accent>own</accent> sites first.
about.intro: Contivo is built by Farjad P.D, founder of {entity}, in Ontario, Canada. It is for a plain problem: a small company knows it should publish steadily and keep an eye on its market, and nobody has the hours to do it well.
about.principlesTitle: The rules it is built on
about.principlesIntro: Each of these is a decision already made in the product, not a promise about one. The date is when it went in.

principles.title: Refuse before inventing
principles.body: In August 2026 the writer produced a client case study that never happened, and the AI reviewer passed it nine out of ten. Since then, a draft that invents a case, a figure or a quote does not get through the quality gate.

principles.title: Show no number that was not measured
principles.body: When the search-data provider is not connected, Contivo now shows no search volume at all, instead of a plausible one it made up.

principles.title: Sell only what works
principles.body: This site used to list networks Contivo cannot post to yet. They came off the page the day that was noticed.

principles.title: Persian is written, not translated
principles.body: A Persian workspace gets articles written in Persian from the start, not English ones with a Persian menu around them.

timeline.title: First commit
timeline.body: A workspace, a connection to LinkedIn and X, and a scheduler.

timeline.title: The strategic report
timeline.body: Contivo starts reading a site and its competitors and writing up what it finds.

timeline.title: Autopilot and the quality gate
timeline.body: It publishes on a schedule, and every draft has to pass a review before it goes out.

timeline.title: Your own website
timeline.body: Besides social networks, Contivo can publish articles straight to your site.

timeline.title: Persian
timeline.body: The whole product, and the writing itself, in Persian.

timeline.title: Early access
timeline.body: Where it is today: free, running on its founder's own sites, and open to try.

stands: Early access. Billing is not live, so it is free.
